## Selected work

- OIP – IoT Fleet Operations Platform (professional, under NDA): event-driven serverless backend for a fleet of connected industrial cleaning machines. 8 Azure Function Apps and 56 functions (29 timer, 14 Service Bus queue, 7 HTTP, 6 Event Hub) in a TypeScript npm-workspaces monorepo. Covers IoT Hub telemetry ingestion via Event Hubs, timezone-aware rolling-window aggregation of usage and battery State-of-Health, high/low-priority Service Bus exports with dead-letter and poison-message recovery, PDF reports on AKS (Puppeteer, Chart.js, Handlebars), field-service integrations, and HTTP APIs behind Azure API Management. Infrastructure as code with Terraform; Azure DevOps CI/CD across dev, stage and prod; Jest tests.
- Industrial IoT Telemetry Pipeline (professional): ingests millions of device events per day through Azure IoT Event Hub, Azure Functions and Service Bus with retries and dead-letter isolation. Improved Azure SQL query performance by 55% through execution-plan analysis, indexing and query refactoring. Instrumented with Azure Monitor and Application Insights.
- Multi-Agent AI Orchestration Platform (personal): central orchestrator that routes tasks to specialized agents, with tools exposed over the Model Context Protocol (MCP) and the platform served through FastAPI. Python, LLMs, tool calling, async workers.
